strings.support.tip: Cockpit is made by one person. An optional gift keeps it going. It opens in your browser; nothing is asked of you.
strings.tour.account-and-users.text: The button showing your name (with a small cog) opens your Cockpit Account, and inside it the Local users button: accounts on this machine, your password, sign out (in the Stand-alone edition the name button opens the user manager directly). Profile holds durable facts about you, sent with every prompt. Slots: which supplier fills each card. Apps: the terminal, file manager and browser the toolbar buttons open.
strings.tour.account-and-users.title: Account and users
strings.tour.artifacts-right-sidebar.text: Everything this project produced, in one list: files agents wrote, generated images and audio, tool outputs and transcripts. Each row says where it came from; open it, reveal its folder, or delete it.
strings.tour.artifacts-right-sidebar.title: Artifacts (right sidebar)
strings.tour.attachments-right-sidebar.text: Files attached to this chat. Text and code go in inline; images and video are processed so the agent can use them; a PDF has its text extracted, and with PDF Vision on its first pages are rendered as images too.
strings.tour.attachments-right-sidebar.title: Attachments (right sidebar)
strings.tour.capabilities-right-sidebar.text: MCP servers and tool-shims that extend what agents can do. One ON/OFF switch per capability, applying to every project and supplier from your next prompt.
strings.tour.capabilities-right-sidebar.title: Capabilities (right sidebar)
strings.tour.card-1-the-primary-cli-agent.text: Claude Code by default (any paid CLI can sit here via Slots). Pick the model and effort, toggle power, open its tmux session or a terminal with the ↗ buttons. The bar shows today's usage against its cap.
strings.tour.card-1-the-primary-cli-agent.title: Card 1 — the primary CLI agent
strings.tour.card-2-the-fallback-cli-free-pro.te: Gemini CLI by default; can be a free REST provider or another CLI. Same controls as card 1. The active card (highlighted) is where Execute sends the prompt.
strings.tour.card-2-the-fallback-cli-free-pro.ti: Card 2 — the fallback CLI / free provider
strings.tour.card-3-local-models.text: Ollama (or LocalAI) on this machine: Tier-1 picks recommended for the 4 GB GPU, favourites, the model manager (database icon) and Power Combos — multi-model recipes that run several local models on one prompt.
strings.tour.card-3-local-models.title: Card 3 — local models
strings.tour.card-4-workers.text: Free and paid REST providers (Groq, OpenRouter, Cloudflare…). "Auto (cascade)" walks your priority list and moves on when a quota runs out. Keys are pasted in the settings gear; the ↗ opens a live activity log.
strings.tour.card-4-workers.title: Card 4 — Workers
strings.tour.card-5-tools.text: Local programs as file→file presets: ffmpeg, pandoc, whisper, ImageMagick, yt-dlp. Pick a preset, Execute opens the input dialog (Browse uploads a file, Server picks one on the machine). Runs are windows in the Tools tmux session (↗) and are recorded in the chat.
strings.tour.card-5-tools.title: Card 5 — Tools
strings.tour.chats.text: Every chat in the current project. + New starts a fresh one; click a chat to switch to it; double-click its name to rename it. Export saves it as JSON and Import loads one back; Detach moves it to the Free pool.
strings.tour.chats.title: Chats
strings.tour.clock.text: Local time (this browser) and the server's time, each with weekday, ISO week and UTC offset — handy when the Cockpit runs on another machine.
strings.tour.clock.title: Clock
strings.tour.code-right-sidebar.text: The code editor, with syntax highlighting, find and replace, line numbers and word wrap. Code blocks from agent answers are extracted here too.
strings.tour.code-right-sidebar.title: Code (right sidebar)
strings.tour.config-right-sidebar.text: Settings that are not on a card: storage paths, attachment routes (which tool handles which file type) and import/export.
strings.tour.config-right-sidebar.title: Config (right sidebar)
strings.tour.execute-plan-clear-save-attach.text: Execute sends to the active card. PLAN hands the goal to the planner (Autopilot Cruise) for a reviewable chain. Save keeps the prompt text; Attach adds files whose content is folded into the prompt.
strings.tour.files.text: The project's working folder as a tree. Click a file to open it in the right sidebar. Map builds a unit map of Pascal and PHP sources; Refresh re-reads the tree from disk.
strings.tour.files.title: Files
strings.tour.help.text: The full guide, searchable. F1 anywhere opens the topic for what is under the mouse. Hover hints appear on everything; the First-Use toggle expands them with summaries.
strings.tour.help.title: Help
strings.tour.hive-autocognition.text: The agent bus: who is on it, task chains (durable, resumable plans) and the consent broker. PLAN on the prompt turns a goal into a chain.
strings.tour.hive-autocognition.title: Hive — AutoCognition
strings.tour.info-bar.text: Current project and chat, the working folder, machine summary, live GPU memory, network latency and session state.
strings.tour.info-bar.title: Info bar
strings.tour.intercom.text: Hands-free: it listens, notices when you stop talking, sends what you said, speaks the answer and listens again. Press again to stop.
strings.tour.intercom.title: Intercom
strings.tour.language.text: The translate button picks the language Cockpit is shown in — English by default, with a growing list of other languages, right-to-left ones (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian...) included. Missing yours? The menu has an empty template to translate.
strings.tour.language.title: Language
strings.tour.left-sidebar-tabs.text: Four tabs: Chats, Projects, Files and Notes. The Hive stays open below them. Each tab is a panel; drag the edge to resize. The next four steps look at each tab in turn — Skip section jumps past them.
strings.tour.left-sidebar-tabs.title: Left sidebar tabs
strings.tour.library-right-sidebar.text: Your knowledge base: books, articles, notes and links. Add a file or scan a folder and the text becomes searchable. Books filed by Bookshelf show as one foldable row. A prompt that matches something here gets the passage added — or the chat says nothing fitted well enough.
strings.tour.library-right-sidebar.title: Library (right sidebar)
strings.tour.mode-and-theme.text: Dark/light mode and the theme editor (36 themes, protanopia-safe Dalton set).
strings.tour.mode-and-theme.title: Mode and Theme
strings.tour.modes.text: Single sends to the active card. Pipeline chains cards in order. Broadcast asks several at once. Plan drafts and runs a multi-step plan. Caveman compresses prompts to online suppliers.
strings.tour.modes.title: Modes
strings.tour.notes.text: A Markdown note store kept inside Cockpit. The scope dropdown switches between Internal (Cockpit's own notes) and Folder (your Notepad folder); ticking +other also searches the other store, read-only.
strings.tour.notes.title: Notes
strings.tour.plans-right-sidebar.text: Plan mode breaks a goal into steps using several agents as voters. Here you view the steps, run them, sequence them or schedule them.
strings.tour.plans-right-sidebar.title: Plans (right sidebar)
strings.tour.power-strip.text: Your Power Buttons, one click each: copy some text (or a picture), click a button, and the answer comes back in a small card. Add buttons from Toolbar → Power Buttons.
strings.tour.power-strip.title: Power Buttons strip
strings.tour.preview-right-sidebar.text: Live preview of the file you select in the file tree: HTML and Markdown are rendered.
strings.tour.preview-right-sidebar.title: Preview (right sidebar)
strings.tour.projects.text: Your projects: each groups chats, files and context. + New creates one (a name and a working folder). Click a project to switch — the chat list, file tree and rules follow. Config edits that project's COCKPIT.md, its own rules and context.
strings.tour.projects.title: Projects
strings.tour.proposals.text: When an agent proposes a file change (%%CREATE%% / %%APPEND%%), it lands here first; a count shows on this tab's icon from anywhere. Nothing touches your files until you approve — one by one, or all at once.
strings.tour.proposals.title: Proposals
strings.tour.right-sidebar-tabs.text: Fourteen tabs: Toolbar, Proposals, Preview, Code, Library, Snippets, Sources, Config, Search, Capabilities, Plans, Artifacts, Attachments and Usage. The Toolbar was covered above; the next steps take the rest in turn — Skip section jumps past them.
strings.tour.right-sidebar-tabs.title: Right sidebar tabs
strings.tour.search-right-sidebar.text: Web search: Brave first, then DuckDuckGo. Open a result, read it into your prompt, or save it to the Library. Public engines increasingly refuse automated queries, so it can come back empty — it says which engine refused.
strings.tour.search-right-sidebar.title: Search (right sidebar)
strings.tour.sessions-and-the-window.text: The agent sessions run in tmux and start with the app: Stop and Restart control them (the chip on Stop counts how many are up, e.g. 3/3), Exit shows what is still running — tool jobs, calls, streams — with the ways to stop it. In the native window the card also holds Reopen, Reload (bypasses the cache), Refresh (re-reads status and account now) and ⛶ frameless; with the frame off, ▁ ▢ beside Exit minimise and maximise.
strings.tour.sessions-and-the-window.title: Sessions and the window
strings.tour.skip.tip: Skip the rest of this section
strings.tour.snippets-right-sidebar.text: Short reusable code and text blocks, one file each, searchable by keyword or by meaning (Deep search). Save one from a chat with F2.
strings.tour.snippets-right-sidebar.title: Snippets (right sidebar)
strings.tour.sources-right-sidebar.text: Whole external projects and programs you refer to — entire codebases, not single files like Snippets. Register one, upload a zip, or let Cockpit scan a folder.
strings.tour.sources-right-sidebar.title: Sources (right sidebar)
strings.tour.status-bar.text: The latest system message, the sidebar toggles, line numbers and the connection state. The Ready/Thinking indicator shows a reply in progress.
strings.tour.status-bar.title: Status bar
strings.tour.styles.text: Chat, Outline, Research, Build, Debug, Analyze, Report — a short instruction prefixed to the prompt. Build is the plain default. "auto model" lets a style pick its preferred model.
strings.tour.styles.title: Styles
strings.tour.that-is-the-cockpit.text: Suggested first flight: pick a card, type a question, Enter. Then try PLAN on a small goal, a Power Combo on card 3, and a pandoc conversion on the Tools card. The full guide (Help) has a step-by-step walkthrough and every setting.
strings.tour.that-is-the-cockpit.title: That is the cockpit
strings.tour.the-chat.text: Every turn is a card: click its title row to fold it; the row stays visible while a long answer scrolls. Copy / save-to-library actions sit on the row. Ctrl+F searches the chat. Tool runs and worker calls are recorded here too.
strings.tour.the-chat.title: The chat
strings.tour.the-prompt.text: Type here. Enter sends; Ctrl+Enter or Shift+Enter add a line; ↑/↓ walk your history; Esc cancels a running reply. Slash commands (/skill) and attachments (paperclip, or drop a file) work here.
strings.tour.the-prompt.title: The prompt
strings.tour.toolbar-accumulator.text: Pulls reusable knowledge out of PDFs and documents with a local pipeline and stores it for retrieval. The chip on the button counts the results gathered so far.
strings.tour.toolbar-accumulator.title: Toolbar · Accumulator
strings.tour.toolbar-bookshelf.text: Splits a book (epub, docx, odt, fb2, mobi…) into chapters and files them in the Library as one foldable row, so even a small local model can work with a whole book. You see the chapter list before anything is written.
strings.tour.toolbar-bookshelf.title: Toolbar · Bookshelf
strings.tour.toolbar-browser.title: Toolbar · Browser
strings.tour.toolbar-delegate.text: Auto-routes tasks that match your rules to a chosen supplier, model or combo before the normal agent carries on.
strings.tour.toolbar-delegate.title: Toolbar · Delegate
strings.tour.toolbar-dossier.text: Researches a question on the web and saves a cited report in the project. It needs web search, which some networks block, so it can come back empty.
strings.tour.toolbar-dossier.title: Toolbar · Dossier
strings.tour.toolbar-files.text: Opens the file window: your Public folder (yours to change) and your project folders (to look at and copy from).
strings.tour.toolbar-files.title: Toolbar · Files
strings.tour.toolbar-image.text: Generates an image locally with stable-diffusion.cpp.
strings.tour.toolbar-image.title: Toolbar · Image
strings.tour.toolbar-jobs.text: Scheduled jobs: a cron-driven task scheduler. The chip counts your jobs and takes the accent colour while any are pending or running.
strings.tour.toolbar-jobs.title: Toolbar · Jobs
strings.tour.toolbar-keys.title: Toolbar · Keys
strings.tour.toolbar-notepad.text: AI-aware notes over a local folder you choose.
strings.tour.toolbar-notepad.title: Toolbar · Notepad
strings.tour.toolbar-power.text: One click runs a saved prompt on what you copied (proofread, summarise, make it polite…), with a model on this computer or a supplier you choose, and puts the answer on your clipboard.
strings.tour.toolbar-power.title: Toolbar · Power Buttons
strings.tour.toolbar-privacy.text: Privacy and spending: a check for secrets and card numbers before a prompt goes to an online agent, a free-agents-only switch, and a monthly budget for paid agents.
strings.tour.toolbar-privacy.title: Toolbar · Privacy
strings.tour.toolbar-rules.text: Directives: global standing rules applied to every supplier (Claude, Gemini, Ollama and Workers), sent with every prompt.
strings.tour.toolbar-rules.title: Toolbar · Rules
strings.tour.toolbar-skills.text: Reusable /trigger prompt templates: type the trigger and the template is expanded into your prompt.
strings.tour.toolbar-skills.title: Toolbar · Skills
strings.tour.toolbar-sound.text: Generates sound locally: speech, effects, a melody or background audio.
strings.tour.toolbar-sound.title: Toolbar · Sound
strings.tour.toolbar-summarize.text: Summarizes the current chat with the active agent, and lets you save the summary.
strings.tour.toolbar-summarize.title: Toolbar · Summarize
strings.tour.toolbar-tasks.text: Background tasks: autonomous goals and recurring jobs.
strings.tour.toolbar-tasks.title: Toolbar · Tasks
strings.tour.toolbar-terminal.text: Opens the command window: simple commands, confined by the system to your Public folder.
strings.tour.toolbar-terminal.title: Toolbar · Terminal
strings.tour.toolbar-track.text: Starts or stops time tracking. Right-click it for the report.
strings.tour.toolbar-track.title: Toolbar · Track
strings.tour.toolbar-transcriber.text: Turns a YouTube video's transcript into an analysed, structured PDF.
strings.tour.toolbar-transcriber.title: Toolbar · Transcriber
strings.tour.toolbar-translate-chat.text: Translates every message in this chat (code excluded) with local LibreTranslate — nothing leaves your machine.
strings.tour.toolbar-translate-chat.title: Toolbar · Translate chat
strings.tour.toolbar-translate-text.text: Opens a free-text translation box, also on local LibreTranslate.
strings.tour.toolbar-translate-text.title: Toolbar · Translate text
strings.tour.toolbar-video.text: Generates a short animated GIF locally.
strings.tour.toolbar-video.title: Toolbar · Video
strings.tour.toolbar.text: Every quick-launch tool, in alphabetical order — twenty-one buttons. Jobs and Stop carry small count chips. The next steps take the buttons one at a time; Skip section jumps past them.
strings.tour.toolbar.title: Toolbar
strings.tour.usage-right-sidebar.text: Token use and quota for every supplier and worker, and paid API spend.
strings.tour.usage-right-sidebar.title: Usage (right sidebar)
strings.tour.voice-input.text: Press to dictate: it records, transcribes on this machine with whisper.cpp and drops the words into the prompt. While you speak, a bar opens beside the button so you can see the microphone is live. The ▾ menu picks the model, language and microphone, and Test level checks the input.
strings.tour.voice-input.title: Voice input
strings.tour.welcome-to-ai-cockpit.text: A local console that drives several AI agents at once — paid CLIs, free workers, local models and file tools — from one prompt, one chat history and one set of files. This tour walks through every part of the screen. Next / Back below, Esc to leave; press F1 on any step for the full help topic.
